worldFact.fact: The open-pit Mir diamond mine in Siberia plunges 525 metres (1,722 feet) deep and spans 1,200 metres across. The immense artificial crater creates downward atmospheric vortexes so violent that the Russian aviation authority strictly banned helicopters from flying over its airspace.

photo.alt: The Storm Tower is a historical landmark in Bude, Cornwall. It was built around 1835 and is modelled on the Tower of the Winds in Athens. It has been moved twice due to coastal erosion.
